# Curated leak-sweep targets for leaksweep.py.
#
# One entry per line: module.py:ClassName.testMethod:budget_seconds
# '#'-prefixed lines and blank lines are ignored.
#
# This list is meant to be hand-curated and reviewed like the original
# test_leak.py spot checks were (see plan/LeakCheckHarness.md) -- not
# auto-generated or auto-discovered. Add a new entry when a leak is found
# and fixed, so the fix gets permanent, systematic regression coverage
# instead of relying on another investigation getting lucky again.
#
# The budgets below are smoke-test sized (60s) so a full sweep finishes in
# a few minutes for local/CI sanity checks. A dedicated overnight/opt-in run
# should use much larger budgets (e.g. 300s+) for real sensitivity, since a
# bigger budget means more batches sampled, not a bigger/slower batch.

test_leak.py:LeakTestCase.testStringLeak:60
test_leak.py:LeakTestCase.testStringLeak__str__:60
test_leak.py:LeakTestCase.testClassLeak:60
test_leak.py:LeakTestCase.testCtorLeak:60
test_leak.py:LeakTestCase.testInvokeLeak:60

# GENERIC entries: point directly at an existing, unmodified test method or
# function (see leaksweep.py's module docstring for the shape) instead of a
# hand-written closure -- the driver supplies the loop/isolation/measurement
# itself via leakharness.runTargetBudget().

# Regression coverage for the testPassedObjectGetsCleanedUp OOM leak fixed
# in jp_context.cpp (see bugs/PassedObjectGetsCleanedUpFlake.md) -- this
# test already loops internally per call, so keep size small.
GENERIC:test_attr.py:AttributeTestCase.testPassedObjectGetsCleanedUp:60:2

# Array-iteration path (the ArrayIterLocalRefLeak.md fix's regression coverage).
GENERIC:test_array.py:ArrayTestCase.testIterateArray:60:200

# JPProxy dynamic-class-generation path -- flagged LEAK during initial
# validation (steady ~5-7KB/call RSS growth, JVM heap flat) but PASSED on
# two later full-config runs at the same budget/size; plausibly expected
# per-call dynamic-class/metaspace cost near the "4 clean batches" noise
# boundary rather than a real leak, since this test defines a brand-new
# @JImplements class every call. Left in deliberately as an open, flaky
# finding for later investigation, not yet a filed bug -- do not treat a
# LEAK (or a PASS) here as conclusive without re-reading this note first.
GENERIC:test_proxy.py:ProxyTestCase.testProxyLeak:60:200

# Direct ByteBuffer conversion + an internal exception round-trip.
# Investigated -- see bugs/DirectBufferLeak.md. Real, confirmed live-RSS
# growth (not a high-water-mark artifact); JPype's own phantom-ref cleanup
# path has zero accounting gap. Most of the growth (~1300-2800 -> ~262
# bytes/call once the test's exception-throwing line is removed) looks
# like the same jp_exception.cpp tb_create traceback leak the parallel
# testCause investigation found and fixed -- re-verify against that fix.
# A smaller ~262 bytes/call residual persists even exception-free and is
# still unexplained (real small leak vs. harness-threshold miscalibration
# for this async-cleanup workload shape -- not yet distinguished).
GENERIC:test_bytebuffer.py:ByteBufferCase.testConvertToDirectBuffer:60

# Multi-dimensional (3D) rectangular array push.
GENERIC:test_arrayRaggedPush.py:ArrayRaggedPushTestCase.testRectangularInt3D:60

# Ragged (jagged) 2D array pull via JArray.toList().
GENERIC:test_arrayToList.py:ArrayToListTestCase.testMultiDimJagged:60

# Bulk primitive-array-to-list pull across every primitive type.
GENERIC:test_arrayToList.py:ArrayToListTestCase.testEachPrimitiveType:60

# Custom user-defined Java class instantiation + non-static field access.
GENERIC:test_attr.py:AttributeTestCase.testGetNonStatic:60

# Numeric widening/boxing: Python int -> boxed java.lang.Long.
GENERIC:test_boxing.py:BoxingTestCase.testBoxedLongFromPythonInt:60

# Java exception throw/catch round-trip with __cause__ traceback chaining.
# Was a real leak (see bugs/ExceptionCauseTracebackLeak.md): tb_create()'s
# last_traceback local was reassigned each loop iteration without a decref,
# leaking every non-final synthetic traceback frame -- fixed in
# native/common/jp_exception.cpp. Now a clean regression check.
GENERIC:test_exc.py:ExceptionTestCase.testCause:60

# java.util.HashMap conversion (dict-like put/get).
GENERIC:test_collection.py:CollectionMapCase.testMapPut:60

# java.util.ArrayList conversion + iteration.
GENERIC:test_collection.py:CollectionListCase.testListAdd:60

# Reflection: java.lang.Class.forName() lookup.
GENERIC:test_forname.py:ForNameTestCase.testForName:60

# Numeric conversion baseline (Python int -> Java int).
GENERIC:test_conversionInt.py:ConversionIntTestCase.testIntFromInt:60

# Numeric widening (Python int -> Java long).
GENERIC:test_conversionLong.py:ConversionLongTestCase.testLongFromInt:60
